verification.method: Byte replay of every struct tag claim on the lock-equal Core.dll and the lock-equal E: maps, every claim supported

tagged.condition: every struct other than the binary ones, when the package Ver is at least 118 and the archive is a package load

binary.condition: the struct FName id is 0x57 Vector, 0x58 Rotator or 0x5a Color; members follow the struct child order

tag.condition: a compact name index, where None ends the stream; then the info byte: type is the low nibble, the size code is info & 0x70 and 0x80 is the array flag; type 10 (struct) reads the struct FName before the size

arrayIndex.condition: read when the info array flag 0x80 is set, never for bool: 1 byte; 2 bytes ((b & 0x7f) << 8 | next) when b & 0x80; 4 bytes ((b & 0x3f) << 24 ...) when b & 0xc0 == 0xc0

bool.condition: type 3: the value is the 0x80 info bit and there is no payload, but the size header is still read, for example 13 53 00 is size code 5 with a uint8 size of 0

nestedStruct.condition: a nested custom struct is tagged and ends with its own None

dynamicArray.condition: a compact count, then each element through the inner property SerializeItem; a struct inner is tagged unless it is Vector, Rotator or Color
